editor.title: Parameters and data rows
editor.hint: Use {{prefix}}name}} in the preconditions and steps. Each data row runs the case once, as one iteration. A value may be a test data reference such as {{dataExample}}; never type a secret here.
editor.noParameters: No parameters. The case runs once.
editor.noRows: No data rows yet. Add one row for each set of values.

errors.invalidName: Use letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
errors.duplicateName: Each parameter needs its own name.
errors.tooManyParameters: A case can have at most {{max}} parameters.
errors.tooManyRows: A case can have at most {{max}} data rows.
errors.rowsWithoutParameters: Add the parameters before the data rows.
errors.parametersWithoutRows: Add at least one data row for the parameters, or remove the parameters.

iteration.title: Iteration {{number}}
iteration.recordHint: Run the case once for each data row and record each iteration on its own.
